query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deployment_environment_variable(deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT, secret_id TEXT,  PRIMARY KEY(deployment_id, name), FOREIGN KEY(deployment_id) REFERENCES deployment(id), CONSTRAINT deployment_environment_variable_chk_name_nonempty CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM(name)) > 0), CONSTRAINT deployment_environment_variable_chk_value_nonempty CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM(value)) > 0), CONSTRAINT deployment_environment_variable_chk_value_secret_id_required CHECK(value IS NOT NULL OR secret_id IS NOT NULL));
